description: This is a unit test class for the AOD_Index module, utilizing the SuiteCRM PHPUnit framework. It contains multiple test methods to verify the behavior and properties of the AOD_Index bean, including creation, enabling status, index retrieval, document generation, module searchability, indexing functionality, and retrieval of indexable modules.

classes.name: AOD_IndexTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the AOD_Index module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testAOD_Index
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and core properties of the AOD_Index bean.

methods.name: testisEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that the isEnabled() method on the AOD_Index bean returns true.

methods.name: testgetIndex
methods.description: Checks that getIndex() returns a new instance of AOD_Index and that it is not the same object as the original.

methods.name: testgetDocumentForBean
methods.description: Ensures getDocumentForBean() returns an array containing a Zend_Search_Lucene_Document for a User bean.

methods.name: testisModuleSearchable
methods.description: Validates the static method isModuleSearchable() for various modules, both searchable and non-searchable.

methods.name: testindex
methods.description: Tests the index() method with modules that are searchable and non-searchable, and with valid or invalid bean IDs.

methods.name: testgetIndexableModules
methods.description: Checks that getIndexableModules() returns the expected list of modules and their associated classes.
